national_news.title: 18th BRICS Summit Begins at New Delhi's Bharat Mandapam
bullets: The 18th BRICS Summit convened at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, bringing together 11 member nations under India's fourth BRICS Chairship.
The official theme of India's Chairship 2026 is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
The summit features newly expanded full members, including Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, alongside original member nations.

national_news.title: India Beats Bangladesh by 40 Runs to Reach Women's Asia Cup 2026 Final
bullets: India defeated Bangladesh by 40 runs in the first semi-final of the Women's Asia Cup 2026 at Dubai.
Player of the Match Shafali Verma top-scored with 64 runs off 40 balls, setting a target of 150 runs.
Deepti Sharma took three wickets as India restricted Bangladesh to 109/7 in 20 overs.

national_news.title: IPC Hosts National Conference on Biosimilars under Biopharma SHAKTI Vision
bullets: The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, organized a national conference in Bengaluru.
The event released the Indian Pharmacopoeia Reference Substance (IPRS) for Enoxaparin Sodium for bioassays to standardize biological activity testing.
The initiative aligns with India's 'Biopharma SHAKTI Vision' to strengthen indigenous pharmaceutical quality infrastructure and global competitiveness.

national_news.title: PM Shri JNV Ukhrul-1 Manipur Wins 27th National Youth Parliament Competition
bullets: Union Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Kiren Rijiju felicitated the winners of the 27th National Youth Parliament Competition (2025-26) organized for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas.
PM Shri Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Ukhrul-1, Manipur (Shillong Region) secured the national top spot and received the Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru Running Parliamentary Shield.
The competition was conducted across 100 Vidyalayas in eight regions of the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti to build parliamentary awareness, debate, and leadership skills among students.

national_news.title: Rubber Cultivation Expands to 33,000 Hectares in Meghalaya with RRII Assistance
bullets: Rubber cultivation in Meghalaya expanded from 10,000 hectares over a decade ago to approximately 33,000 hectares, supported by the Rubber Research Institute of India (RRII), Kottayam.
The Rubber Board provides technical support through its Tura Regional Office and eight field stations, focusing heavily on the Garo Hills region.
Group Processing Centres (GPCs) were set up under Green Hill RPS and Laurel Hills RPS in Mendipathar to facilitate local latex processing into rubber sheets for higher value addition.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses International Space Summit in Paris, Outlines Space Targets
bullets: PM Narendra Modi virtually addressed the International Space Summit in Paris, advocating for a peaceful space domain anchored in international law and the spirit of 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam'.
Reiterated India's long-term targets to establish the Bharatiya Antariksha Station (Indian Space Station) by 2035 and land an Indian astronaut on the Moon by 2040.
Highlighted ISRO's key achievements, including Chandrayaan-3 landing near the lunar south pole, Aditya-L1 mission, and launching over 430 satellites for 34 countries.

national_news.title: India and Russia Pursue Joint Production of Civil Passenger Aircraft
bullets: India's Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu and Russia's Industry Minister Anton Alikhanov held discussions during the 'Innoprom India' event in New Delhi on joint manufacturing of civil commuter planes.
Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd. (HAL) and Russia's United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) previously inked an MoU for licensed joint production of the Superjet (SJ-100) in India.
Discussions included potential deliveries and arrangements for 105 regional turboprop aircraft to Indian regional airlines to bolster domestic air connectivity.

national_news.title: Centre Amends Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020 to Ban Dark Patterns and Fake Discounts
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution amended the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020, coming into effect on January 1 next year.
Under new rules, discounted prices must disclose the 'prior price', defined strictly as the lowest price at which the product was offered during the preceding 30 days.
E-commerce entities are forbidden from manipulating search results or using dark patterns, and must mandate country-of-origin disclosures and integrate with the National Consumer Helpline.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Chairs 3rd NIDM Governing Body Meeting; Sets Zero-Casualty Vision
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired the 3rd Governing Body meeting of the National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) in New Delhi, emphasizing a 'zero-casualty' vision and disaster-resilient infrastructure.
Highlighted a fourfold increase in State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) allocations and a threefold increase in National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) allocations.
Directed NDMA and NIDM to issue joint nationwide guidelines, track global climate risk research, and maintain permanent readiness for challenges like locust swarm attacks.

national_news.title: India and Russia Target $100 Billion Bilateral Trade Mark by 2030
bullets: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and Russian Minister Anton Alikhanov co-chaired the INNOPROM India 2026 session, targeting $100 billion in bilateral trade and $50 billion in two-way investments by 2030.
Both nations are fast-tracking a new Bilateral Investment Treaty (BIT) while tracking 40 live priority projects in manufacturing, energy, mining, and railways.

India has begun formal Free Trade Agreement (FTA) negotiations with the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) and called for enhanced local currency payments and utilization of INSTC and Chennai-Vladivostok maritime corridors.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Transfers ₹1,233 Crore under Social Security Pension Scheme via DBT
bullets: The Bihar government transferred ₹1,233.87 crore directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank accounts of over 1.05 crore social security pensioners.
Under the scheme, beneficiaries including senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities receive ₹1,100 per month, with 98,896 new beneficiaries added.

The state announced that social security pensions will be transferred on the 10th of every month, alongside laying the foundation stone for widening National Highway 333 from Gangta (Munger) to Kodwarva (Jamui).

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Launch Month-Long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' Campaign
bullets: Bihar Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit reviewed preparations for the state-wide 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' (Service Pledge Campaign) scheduled from September 17 to October 17.
The campaign features 13 key components including 'Aashirwad ka Diya' (household lamp lighting), 'Seva Chitra' (school competitions), and 'Aangan ka Milan' at Anganwadi centers.
It incorporates 25 public engagement activities under 'Seva Mera Yogdan', such as cleaning Chhath ghats and planting trees in at least two locations per assembly constituency.

bihar_news.title: NFHS-6 Highlights Divergent Demographic Trends Across Indian States
bullets: According to the 6th National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), India's Total Fertility Rate (TFR) stands at 2.0 children per woman, dropping below the replacement level of 2.1.
Out of 36 states and UTs, 34 are now at or below replacement fertility, leaving only Bihar and Meghalaya above the replacement threshold.

Projections show that by 2051, Uttar Pradesh (132 million) and Bihar (111 million) will drive the majority of India's net working-age population growth as workforce growth flattens in southern states.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets 25 New Sugar Mills Under Sugarcane Investment Policy 2026
bullets: The Bihar government unveiled the Sugarcane Investment Policy 2026 during a two-day investors' conference in New Delhi on September 9-10, 2026.
The state targets the establishment of 25 new sugar mills and value-added industries focused on ethanol, power generation, and bio-energy.
Union Secretary Santosh Kumar Sarangi inaugurated the event, which aims to boost private investment and agricultural employment in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: BREDA Initiates Tender for 500 MW Rooftop Solar on Government Buildings Under RESCO Model
bullets: The Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency (BREDA) floated a tender to empanel solar developers for 500 MW of grid-connected rooftop solar projects.
Projects will be executed under the Renewable Energy Service Company (RESCO) model on government buildings across Bihar.
The RESCO structure enables solar deployment without upfront capital expenditure or operational responsibilities for building owners.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's Sattu and Makhana Featured in Special Goodie Bags at BRICS Summit 2026
bullets: Special goodie bags curated for international delegates and journalists at the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi prominently featured Bihar's traditional Sattu and Makhana.
The summit is scheduled for September 12-13, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam, bringing together representatives from BRICS member and partner nations.
The hampers also showcased regional products like Odisha's Arabica coffee and Gujarat's block-printed stoles to promote Indian culture and cuisine.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt Announces Fixed DBT Pension Schedule, Health Screening and School Abhiyan
bullets: Fixed the 10th of every month for transferring social security pensions via DBT, disbursing ₹1,233.87 crore to 105.68 lakh beneficiaries at ₹1,100 each.

Announced a state health screening drive from September 1 to November 30, 2026, aiming to screen 6.5 crore citizens, along with 'Seva Sankalp Kayakalp Abhiyan' starting September 17 to improve school infrastructure.
Laid foundation for widening NH-333 and detailed a ₹150 crore development project for the Munger-Jamui forest area, including eco-tourism facilities at Bhim Bandh.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Partner with Google India to Train School Teachers in AI Skills
bullets: Bihar is set to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Google India to strengthen Artificial Intelligence (AI) skills among school teachers.
The agreement will be signed between the Director of SCERT (State Council of Educational Research and Training) and Google India.
The initiative aims to expand technology-based learning across state schools, Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls' Schools, and secondary schools with ICT labs.

bihar_news.title: Prayas Group Recommends 40% Technical Minimum Operational Level for Thermal Power in Bihar
bullets: Energy policy think-tank Prayas submitted recommendations to the Bihar Electricity Regulatory Commission (BERC) regarding the draft Bihar Electricity Grid Code 2026.
It urged BERC to recognize a 40% technical minimum operational capability for coal plants instead of 55%, aligning with Central Electricity Authority (CEA) 2023 regulations.
The group recommended structuring grid tariffs and peak/off-peak hours based on 'net load' to accommodate higher integration of variable solar and wind power.

bihar_news.title: AAI Floats Tender for Saharsa Airport Upgrade in Bihar's Kosi Region
bullets: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has issued a tender worth ₹42.52 crore for the development and upgradation of Saharsa Airport.
The Bihar government is providing 12 acres of land for the airport project at an estimated cost of ₹147 crore.
The project aims to significantly boost air connectivity, trade, and tourism in Bihar's Kosi region.
